messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — customer (Dr. Patel at LumenCare) asked for SOC2 evidence + a sample DPA clause and a 30m enablement call. They want log retention info, redaction options, and KMS key provenance. Sales flagged potential renewal risk if we miss their audit window.

ryan_sales: Thanks Maya. Can we get this to them by EOW? renewal risk noted on the account. I'll coordinate commercial side.

sam_sec: I can supply retention & redaction details. Quick Q: is the ask for production-only or prod + dedicated staging? affects logs we can share.

maya_cs: Prod + Dedicated staging. They want 12mo retention for access logs and ability to request redacted request traces for lawful review. Also asked for an attestation copy of our SOC2 report (redacted).

alex_legal: I can draft a short DPA clause for key provenance and redaction. Posting a minimal sample below — feel free to tweak.

alex_legal: ```
Data Access & Audit Assistance. Vendor shall provide, upon Customer's reasonable written request and subject to applicable law and contractual confidentiality obligations, (i) documentation evidencing Vendor's SOC2 Type II attestation and scope, (ii) redacted access logs and request traces sufficient to demonstrate processing activity related to Customer's tenant, and (iii) key provenance information for cryptographic keys used to protect Customer data. Requests shall be fulfilled within 10 business days unless otherwise agreed. Vendor will not disclose secrets or PII beyond redacted logs.
```

sam_sec: That clause looks good. From infra: we can provide 12mo retention for request logs and can run a one-off redact-and-export process. For KMS provenance: we'll supply key creation date, KMS ARN, and rotation policy excerpt (no private key material).

ops-bot: Uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3/attestations/soc2-redacted-2025.pdf and https://redwood-internal.s3/runbooks/log-redaction-playbook.md 

maya_cs: Perfect — can we bundle those links + Alex's clause into a one-pager for the customer and schedule the 30m call? Prefer Thurs 10am PT or Fri 11am PT.

ryan_sales: Thurs 10am PT works for me, I'll block and send calendar invite to Dr. Patel. I'll include legal & security on the invite.

alex_legal: I'll prepare a 1-page DPA addendum (editable) and share a Google doc link here by EOD.

sam_sec: I'll prepare a short slide (2 bullets) summarizing retention, redaction workflow, and KMS metadata to bring to the call.

maya_cs: Thanks all. Quick action items: Alex — DPA addendum draft (EOD). Sam — slide + attestation excerpt (before call). Ops-bot links are the attestation and runbook. Ryan — calendar invite to customer.

ryan_sales: Got it. Marked as priority. If we can close before their audit, it's a major churn reducer. :thumbsup:

maya_cs: I'll follow up with a pre-call checklist and customer-specific notes. Thanks team! :pray:
